set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var errorIdentifier = error.errorType.identifier default 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR' --- Mule::p(errorIdentifier ++ '.code') default 500]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json var errorIdentifier = error.errorType.identifier default 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR' var description = error.description default 'No description is present' --- { "status": false, "appName": Mule::p("app.name"), "timestamp": now() >> "UTC", "correlationId": correlationId, "errors": { "code": vars.httpStatus default 500, "reason": if ( !isEmpty(error.muleMessage.payload) ) error.muleMessage.payload.errors.reason else (errorIdentifier default "HTTP:INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR"), "message": if ( !isEmpty(error.muleMessage.payload) and (error.muleMessage.payload.errors.message contains "https://") ) "some server side error occurred" else if ( !isEmpty(error.muleMessage.payload) ) error.muleMessage.payload.errors.message else if ( description contains "https://" ) "some server side error occurred"
else (description default "some server side error occurred") } }

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Error Occurred
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[import modules::JSONLoggerModule output application/json --- { payload: JSONLoggerModule::stringifyNonJSON(payload), attributes: JSONLoggerModule::stringifyNonJSON(attributes), error: JSONLoggerModule::stringifyNonJSON(error) }]
